name: EPIC 220506157
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 15.9 solar radii and 1.26 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 220506157 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.864925 (16th-84th percentiles 14.834511-16.992859), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 220506157 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.255201 (16th-84th percentiles 1.073609-1.467775), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 220506157: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 5007.5063 +/- 139 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 220506157 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2612.34375 (16th-84th percentiles 2474.921875-2758.398438), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = -0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,612 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.26 solar masses and 15.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,008 K at its surface.
